analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 2 sessions. RSI at 34.8 entering oversold territory, and ADX at 31.4 indicating a clear trend but lacking directional conviction (+DI 13.8, -DI 30.9) leading to continued sideways movement. Volume ratio of 0.38 shows subdued activity, lowering confidence in trend reversal. 5-day volatility: +0.80% → +0.52% → -0.38% → -4.59% → +0.42%, confirming reduced volatility and lack of clear direction.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for observation persist; buying requires confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and increased volume.
